'''High trooper''' was a military rank used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was placed above [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] and bellow [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]. The Rebel rank of high trooper was equivalent to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>
